subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat add a separate New messages indicator preference, and should it live as browser-local UI state instead of gateway/openclaw.json config?
rationale: Current main already solved the adjacent auto-scroll request, but hiding or replacing the catch-up affordance changes WebChat reading behavior and may add a new settings/config contract.

options.title: Browser-local indicator setting
options.body: Add a persisted UI setting for banner, none, or dismissible behavior while preserving the current default and an accessible jump-to-latest action.

options.title: No separate banner setting
options.body: Treat the existing auto-scroll modes as sufficient and keep New messages as the mandatory manual catch-up affordance.

options.title: Gateway config policy
options.body: Add a documented gateway/openclaw.json config surface with schema and docs if maintainers want deployment-wide WebChat indicator policy.

recommendation.title: Browser-local indicator setting
recommendation.body: Add a persisted UI setting for banner, none, or dismissible behavior while preserving the current default and an accessible jump-to-latest action.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owned the adjacent chatAutoScroll selector and already separated this issue from that merged work in discussion.
